compatibility: A compatible rotary handpiece or motor tool and correct-size mandrel are still required; none shown in these photographs.
Mandrel/shaft fit, disc mounting method, rated RPM, and exact abrasive composition must be confirmed before powered use.

safety: Wear impact-rated eye protection; use suitable dust capture/ventilation and secure each workpiece.
Verify disc mounting, manufacturer's operating speed and tool compatibility before running; keep hair, sleeves and hands clear.
Begin gently on scrap; abrasives can remove plating, solder mask, PCB copper, printed markings or delicate plastic quickly.
Use only on unpowered, disconnected parts. Do not grind live circuits, assembled battery packs, lithium cells or energized equipment.
Avoid contact with the skin and never exceed rated speed or use cracked/damaged attachments.
